d:
Short, messy ash brown hair with jagged bangs. Narrow, almond-shaped amber eyes with a cautious expression. Apparent age of late teens with a youthful, soft face. Slender, lean build. A forest-green tunic over a beige undershirt, paired with brown leather boots and a simple brown belt. A small brown leather pouch attached to the waist and a simple brown scarf wrapped loosely around the neck.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
